notes: These are realistic trigger + execution prompts. Run them via skill-creator's evaluation loop. Add assertions before iterating.

evals.prompt: I inherited this TS project last week and honestly it feels like a mess. Help me figure out where to start cleaning it up — what's actually dead, what's just ugly, and which files should I touch first.
evals.expected_output: scan + priority output, narrative review citing top-tier files with file:line evidence, suggested apply order, no auto-fix

evals.prompt: Before I open this PR, can you look at what I've changed against main and tell me if there's anything obviously bad? Files in the diff are mostly under src/renderer.
evals.expected_output: branch-diff mode scan, issues filtered to changed lines, narrative review focused only on diff

evals.prompt: Review PR #142 — it's adding the new auth middleware. I want to know if there's anything sketchy about the way they handle the token. Bonus points if you flag any type-cast escape hatches.
evals.expected_output: pr mode via gh, surfaces as-any / ts-ignore in changed files, security signals if any

evals.prompt: is src/lib/markdown-renderer.ts ok? feels like it's getting bloated
evals.expected_output: single-file mode, ast+placeholders+comments+complex-type findings for that one file, short summary

evals.prompt: 我们这个项目跑了一年了，types 越来越复杂，循环依赖也开始出来，删都不知道从哪删起。能帮我过一遍吗？
evals.expected_output: trigger Chinese-language messy-codebase phrasing; full audit with focus on circular-dep + complex-type
